_about: Forever travel facts shared by the planner (tools/travel.js) and the addon (TravelData.lua, generated by tools/gen-travel-data.js). Edit here only. Maps are uiMapIDs, coords 0-1.
_MOUNT: Riding from level 40 (Apprentice, 100g on Forever, first mount included): 60% faster than running. docs/research/world-facts.md
_HOSTILE_SEC: Riding through a town or camp of the other faction (tools/hostile-towns.json): seconds added for the detour, guards and players - possible, fine for PvP, but trouble.

_ZONE_MIN_HORDE: A Horde player's zone levels where they differ from ZONE_MIN (which keeps the Alliance out of Horde land at 60): their own start zones and Silverpine (Classic levels).

via.name: the breach east of Mor'shan Rampart

_LIFTS: Lifts the walk maps cannot ride, by area id (map points 0-100 on that area's map): tools/crossings.js joins the bottom and top floors of each (VoxNav.addLifts). Thunder Bluff: QuestieDB objects "Elevator to Mulgore" (50496-50528), the top stations. Undercity: the three shafts under the Ruins of Lordaeron throne room, found in the walk map (city floor z -63..-66 to the throne room floor z ~36; Tirisfal 61.5-62.3, 68.5-69.0) - not checked in game.
_BOATS_races: A 5th entry on a crossing lists the races (or classes: the druids-only hippogryph out of Moonglade) that may use it: the Dalaran-Stormwind portal is Skyborne-only (Method, "how to get to all starting zones", Nov 2026). Other races reach Dalaran overland through Hillsbrad.
_BOATS_faction: A 6th entry names the one faction that can use a crossing (none: both). The Alliance ones dock in Alliance towns or cities; the zeppelins are Horde (Forever adds no Horde portal: Method, Conquest Capped). Spells and gates take a faction field the same way.
_SPELLS: class spells that take you somewhere from anywhere (one way): class, from level, the dock you land at, cast seconds, what you do Mage teleports checked on Wowhead Forever (changes/spellbook/mage, 2026-11-10): all six city teleports unchanged; Forever adds Teleport: Dalaran at 50 (not modelled).
_BOATS_portals: No dock portals: QuestieDB 1.0.14 has 'Portal To ...' objects at most docks and zeppelin towers, but they were Blizzard's temporary launch-week fix while boats and zeppelins got lost (blue post, Aggrend, 2026-11-05: https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/zeppelins-broken/2401777; reported gone 2026-11-06). Routes use the boats and zeppelins.
_BOATS_loop: The Menethil ship is a one-way loop: Menethil -> Southshore -> Auberdine -> Menethil (Method, All Travel Routes in WoW Forever, 2026-10-14: https://www.method.gg/wow-forever/all-travel-routes-in-wow-forever-boats-zeppelins). Its three legs carry the 7th entry true (one way).
_BOATS_powderfuse: Steamwheedle Port (Tanaris) <-> Powderfuse Port (Riverglades), both factions: warcraft.wiki.gg Riverglades, wowforever.be flight-paths guide, classicwowforever.com zones. Docks at the wharfmasters (Steamfizzle 67.56,23.1; Whizzbuzz 79.34,52.75; QuestieDB, Wowhead Forever agrees); the pier itself is not published. No Booty Bay ship (wowforever.be lists only Ratchet).
_ZONE_MIN_new: Riverglades 36 (quests require 36; Wowhead zone tooltip 36-44), Shen'dralas 35 (quests 38-43, most require 30, some 35), Mount Hyjal 54 (quests 56-60 require 54): QuestieDB.
_BOATS_oneway_dalaran: The Dalaran-Stormwind portal is one way: from the Violet Citadel to the Mage Tower, none back (a Skyborne tester, Nov 2026).
_NO_CROSS: Zone borders the walk-map scan joins but the game does not let you walk over (pairs of UI map ids). Dun Morogh/Wetlands: mountains - the way is through Loch Modan and Dun Algaz.
_TRANSFER: Seconds added to every boat, tram, zeppelin and portal hop on top of its own time: getting off one thing and onto the next is a step to read and a chance to miss it, so a trip with an extra change has to save more than this to win. Refuge Pointe to Stormwind: fly to Ironforge and take the tram won by 3 s over the flight to Stormwind (a Skyborne tester, Nov 2026).
